purpose: Assess technical feasibility of removing privileged ledger source access in a paired development experiment; this does not establish causal memory effects.
comparison_deviation: The ledger arm gets a deterministic computed active policy from the SAME public event packet, the summary arm does not; representation and token lengths differ. Equal source access is NOT matched computation, memory budget or equivalent content.
breakdown: 2 episodes x (18 turns x 2 model arms + 5 compactions) = 82 real calls
